verdict.rationale: HeyGen's API documents an endpoint that returns the user's credit balance and plan tier for in-app credit displays. That offers thin support for tracking spend afterwards, and a Stripe-backed project wallet funds API usage. Nothing in the evidence shows a cost estimate before a generation runs. missing for 10: pre-generation credit/dollar cost estimate, per-generation spend history or usage reports, dashboard-level spend tracking for marketers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile, credit balance, and plan tier — useful for in-app credit displays and account UIs.
Fund API usage with a Stripe-backed project wallet
